# Actions and action queues

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## ActionExists

Checks whether you have an action with this name. Big and small letters do not matter.

```csharp
bool ActionExists(string actionName)
```

**Gives back:** true when the action exists, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool exists = CPH.ActionExists("Raid Alert");
CPH.LogInfo($"Raid Alert exists: {exists}");
```

## GetActions

Gives you a list of all your actions, each with its id, name, group, whether it is on, how many sub-actions it has, and its queue.

```csharp
List<ActionData> GetActions()
```

**Gives back:** A list of your actions.

**Example**

```csharp
var actions = CPH.GetActions();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {actions.Count} actions.");
```

## EnableAction

Turns an action on, by its name. If no action has that name, Cuebot writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
void EnableAction(string actionName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableAction("Raid Alert");
```

## DisableAction

Turns an action off, by its name, so its triggers no longer run it. If no action has that name, Cuebot writes a warning in the log.

```csharp
void DisableAction(string actionName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableAction("Raid Alert");
```

## EnableActionById

Turns an action on, by its id. Stops your code with an error when no action has that id.

```csharp
void EnableActionById(string actionId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableActionById("5f2c1a7e-3b4d-4e8f-9a10-2b3c4d5e6f70");
```

## DisableActionById

Turns an action off, by its id. Stops your code with an error when no action has that id.

```csharp
void DisableActionById(string actionId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableActionById("5f2c1a7e-3b4d-4e8f-9a10-2b3c4d5e6f70");
```

## RunAction

Runs another action by its name, with this action's variables. By default it runs now and waits for it. Pass false to put it in its queue and go on at once.

```csharp
bool RunAction(string actionName, bool runImmediately = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked (or was queued). false when no action has that name.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.RunAction("Shoutout");
CPH.LogInfo($"Shoutout worked: {ok}");
```

## RunActionById

Runs another action by its id, with this action's variables. By default it runs now and waits. Pass false to queue it and go on at once.

```csharp
bool RunActionById(string actionId, bool runImmediately = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked (or was queued). false when no action has that id.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.RunActionById("5f2c1a7e-3b4d-4e8f-9a10-2b3c4d5e6f70");
CPH.LogInfo($"Ran it: {ok}");
```

## PauseActionQueue

Pauses an action queue by its name. Actions waiting in it stay there until you resume it.

```csharp
void PauseActionQueue(string queueName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.PauseActionQueue("Alerts");
```

## ResumeActionQueue

Starts a paused action queue again. Pass true as the second value to throw away the actions still waiting in it first.

```csharp
void ResumeActionQueue(string queueName, bool clear = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResumeActionQueue("Alerts", true);
```

## PauseAllActionQueues

Pauses every action queue at once. Handy for a "be right back" break.

```csharp
void PauseAllActionQueues()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.PauseAllActionQueues();
```

## ResumeAllActionQueues

Starts every action queue again. Pass true to throw away all waiting actions first.

```csharp
void ResumeAllActionQueues(bool clear = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResumeAllActionQueues();
```
